titulo.alumno: Novice · Family and close people: Listening comprehension

intro: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammar structures and short sentences from everyday life. Topic: Family and close people. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

texto: Listening to family relationships: in spoken Thai, clearly tell apart the falling tone of «พ่อ» [phɔ̂ɔ] and «แม่» [mɛ̂ɛ] from the high tone of «น้อง» [nɔ́ɔng]. When you hear the sentence «พี่มีน้องสองคน», identify the subject «พี่» (older brother/sister), the verb «มี» (to have) and the quantified phrase «น้องสองคน» (two younger siblings). Hearing the difference in relative age is vital for understanding family trees and everyday conversation.

opciones.texto: Living together across several generations nurtures affection and unity in the home.

piezas.audio: พี่มีน้องสองคน

opciones.texto: The older brother has two younger siblings
opciones.explicacion: Correct: «พี่» (older) has («มี») two younger siblings («น้องสองคน»).

opciones.texto: The mother has two older siblings
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not mention the mother («แม่»).

opciones.texto: The father is alone at home
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not mention the father («พ่อ») or the house («บ้าน»).
